character_sheet: The Ghost's heavier sister: a pumpkin-headed scarecrow ghost on a one-block-wide stem body - a 7x5x7 head with a 1x2x1 stem on top, a 5x12x5 shirt over a 1x21x1 body pole, two 15-long arm bars, two 9x8x3 sleeves and a chain hanging from each arm, 16 tall on the left and 10 on the right (GhostSkellyModel.java:48-96), drawn translucent (GhostSkellyRenderer.java:49-51). It passes through blocks (noPhysics, GhostSkelly.java:62), drifts toward a spot beside the nearest player within 16 blocks or to a random air pocket (GhostSkelly.java:123-164) and hurts whoever it touches: 4 contact damage within 1.8 blocks every 20 ticks, no melee goal (GhostSkelly.java:108-121, doHurtTarget :80-83). It spawns at night, in Halloween week anywhere and year-round in snowy taiga, taiga, frozen river, jungle and dark forest (GhostSkelly.java:200-213). Read it as a hanged scarecrow adrift: arms and chains swaying on slow, unequal beats, the pumpkin head spinning full circle now and then.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.05 of the rig (GhostSkellyRenderer.java:26, 38) on a 128x64 sheet (GhostSkellyModel.java:98); the hitbox is 1.5 x 2.0 (ModEntities.java:644-645); no shadow (SHADOW 0.0 x 1.05, GhostSkellyRenderer.java:28).

behaviour: Two arm assemblies swing as rigid units (GhostSkellyModel.java:109-116): the left arm bar, left sleeve and left chain share one roll about z (cos(t x 0.2) x pi x 0.05, 9 deg) and one sway about y (cos(t x 0.24) x pi x 0.05); the right bar, sleeve and chain share a roll at 0.22 and a sway at 0.26. Four unequal beats, so the two sides never keep step.

Every arm, sleeve and chain part pivots at the rig's origin (PartPose.offset(0, 0, 0), GhostSkellyModel.java:68-96), so the 15-long arm bars and the hanging chains swing from the body's centre line, not from a shoulder.

The head swivels in one cycle of three (GhostSkellyModel.java:117-130): newangle = cos(t x 0.05) x 2 pi - two full turns out and back over a 125.7-tick (6.28 s) cycle - applied only in a cycle whose boundary roll (1 in 3, entity.getRandom().nextInt(3) == 1 at :122) set the per-entity latch (RenderInfo rf2 / ri2, GhostSkelly.java:51-57); in the other cycles the head sits square (newangle = 0, :127-129). A client-side roll, not a server state.
The body pole, the shirt and the stem never move; nothing scales with walking speed (limbSwingAmount unused); the head ignores netHeadYaw, so the LookAtPlayerGoal (GhostSkelly.java:67) turns nothing.

The visible travel is the entity's own drift, not a pose: customServerAiStep eases the motion toward a flight target beside the nearest player or a random air pocket (GhostSkelly.java:123-164), turns the yaw a sixth of the way per tick (:166-169) and damps the vertical motion to 0.65 each tick (:86-91); it hovers with noPhysics (:62).
Drawn translucent through entityTranslucent (GhostSkellyRenderer.java:49-51) at x1.05 (GhostSkellyRenderer.java:38).
